description: Day 14 capped what a miss can cost. Today opens a new part of the course: how do you know an AI feature is still doing its job?
line: A triage prompt change lifts accuracy from 91% to 94% on 1,000 labelled support messages and ships past the 92% bar, while unauthorised-payment reports sent to the wrong queue rise from 3 to 18 of 30; under PSD2 they need a refund by the end of the next business day
title: Day 15 — Up 3 Points, 6× Worse
